comment: Repo-wide user-facing SemVer (used by the MSI, GitHub Releases, and as the base
for each handler DLL when no nested version.json is in scope).
Per-DLL independent versions live in nested version.json files alongside each
handler's source so Git height (commits since the last version bump) is scoped
to that subtree. CI flows $(BuildVersion) from Nerdbank.GitVersioning into the
RC FILEVERSION via build/version.props. The MSI uses 3-part Major.Minor.Patch.
